title: 179 Pine Needle Way Vacation Rental
meta_description: 179 Pine Needle Way is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Nestled in the peaceful Forest District, 179 Pine Needle Way is a beautiful coastal retreat designed for families seeking both relaxation and luxury. With a private pool, 6-passenger electric cart, and four adult bikes, this stylish home offers the perfect combination of comfort and convenience just minutes from Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with up to 8 Passes Included 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental 6-Passenger Electric Cart Included in Rental Parking for 2 Vehicles Natural Gas Grill Exterior Shower Private Pool (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1–May 1) Easy Access to Camp WaterColor or the Shopping and Dining of WaterColor Crossing 7-Minute Electric Cart Ride to WaterColor Beach Club and Beach Access 3-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 7-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Welcome to 179 Pine Needle Way, a beautifully appointed home offering the best of WaterColor living. The spacious front porch invites guests to relax in one of four comfortable chairs with an ice-cold drink in hand, the perfect place to enjoy the neighborhood’s laid-back charm. Inside, soft coastal hues and dark hardwood floors create a warm, refined atmosphere. The open living area flows seamlessly into the dining space and fully equipped kitchen, featuring white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and bright countertops. Whether you’re preparing breakfast or a family-style dinner, this kitchen is as functional as it is inviting. The dining area comfortably seats eight, creating the ideal gathering place for friends and family. Step through the back door to discover your private outdoor oasis. The enclosed porch opens onto a fenced backyard complete with a sparkling private pool, built-in grill area, and outdoor kitchen equipped with a gas barbecue, burners, and a refrigerator, perfect for alfresco dining. The home’s three spacious bedrooms ensure comfort and privacy for every guest. The primary suite offers a king bed, private bathroom with soaking tub and walk-in shower, and easy access to the pool area. A second king guest room features a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, while the third bedroom includes a king bed and two twin beds, along with its own private bath and stall shower. With four adult bikes and a 6-passenger electric cart, exploring WaterColor’s scenic paths, Camp WaterColor, and nearby Seaside is effortless. From poolside mornings to evenings spent under the stars, 179 Pine Needle Way delivers an exceptional WaterColor experience for families and friends alike.Sleeping Arrangements Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2) and Two Twin Beds (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Washer and Dryer Life in WaterColor Located in the Forest District, this home offers close access to Camp WaterColor, the Crossings shops, and the community’s scenic trails. With its private pool, electric cart, and easy access to the Beach Club, 179 Pine Needle Way combines the comforts of home with the beauty of coastal living.
